A later review strengthened the manifest gate to consume Rolldown chunk.modules metadata and prompted reset of stale copy feedback on source changes.
Frontend and root frozen-lockfile installs pass and both maintained importers resolve Mermaid 11.16.1 and Shiki 4.4.2.
The production manifest's recursive initial static closure contains only index.html, Rolldown runtime, assistant, React, and query chunks; both named engine entries are dynamic.
The project has no .kbd-orchestrator/constraints.md, so the C-09 OpenSpec requirements are the blocking constraint authority.
